document.abstract: The use of high-speed motion pictures has made it possible to analyze extremely rapid motions associated with explosion phenomena and high-impact shock. In order to do this efficiently, certain techniques have been developed in the preparation of the test specimen and the calibration and measurement of the results on the film.
